bullets.text: Sweden Embraces Cash Again — After years of digital payment dominance, Sweden is now prioritising cash resilience amid cybersecurity and geopolitical concerns, impacting consumer trust and financial stability.
Suriname Prepares for Oil Boom — With a significant offshore oil discovery, Suriname's fintech sector is poised to modernise financial services, aiming for economic inclusivity as wealth increases.
AI Adoption in Banking — HSBC's appointment of a Chief AI Officer highlights the shift towards integrating artificial intelligence in banking, focusing on workforce readiness over technology alone.
FCA Supports Innovative Firms — The UK's Financial Conduct Authority has launched a Scale-up Unit to assist fast-growing fintech firms in navigating regulations and fostering sustainable growth.
Simplifying Compliance with API — The FCA's new API for its Handbook aims to ease compliance burdens for firms, allowing better integration of regulatory standards into their systems.
